bullets.title: NVDA/AI Semi selloff: 5σ move, 10%+ SOX decline Friday; CEO calls it a buying opportunity
bullets.body: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 10% Friday—worst day since March 2020—driven by AVGO earnings disappointment, equity supply concerns (Google $85B raise, Meta considering large offering), rising rate fears post-strong payrolls, and levered ETF ($100B+ AUM) forced selling. NVDA CEO Jensen Huang called it a buying opportunity, partnered with SK Hynix on multi-year AI memory deal, and confirmed supply chain demand is 'enormous from wafers to silicon photonics and cable connectors.' SOX had been 76% above 200-day MA before the selloff; markets are rebounding ~+1% Monday premarket.

bullets.title: MU: UBS raises PT to $1,625 on DRAM/NAND pricing surge and agentic AI demand
bullets.body: UBS models FQ3:26 revenue of $36B and EPS of $20.96—well ahead of guidance—with DRAM ASP +45% Q/Q and NAND ASP +50% Q/Q. HBM revenue modeled at $2.9B. Gross margin expected ~83% (210bps above guidance). UBS also raises DDR5/NAND pricing forecasts (DDR5 ex-LTA +67% Q2, +17% Q3) and HBM blended ASPs +66% YoY in 2027. Jensen Huang said memory shortage 'will last quite a few years.' SOCAMM2 spec reduction to 768GB is net neutral/slightly accretive per UBS.

bullets.title: MRVL joins S&P 500 (June 22); Jensen Huang called it 'next trillion dollar company'
bullets.body: Marvell and Flex will replace Pool Corp and Campbell Soup in the S&P 500 effective June 22; MRVL was +8.5% in premarket Monday. Jensen Huang publicly endorsed MRVL as a key AI infrastructure enabler across interconnect, silicon photonics, and NVLink Fusion. Custom silicon business forecast to surpass $10B revenue by FY2029. CXL revenue expected at $1B+ by CY28.

bullets.title: ORCL: Buy into print; Oppenheimer and JPM bullish on OCI acceleration
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raised PT to $275 (from $235) and recommends buying ahead of June 10 F4Q earnings, projecting OCI revenue of $180M (+96% YoY) with 400bps beat vs consensus; expects management to raise FY27 OCI guidance by $1B+ to $35B+. JPM also flagged ORCL as a key earnings catalyst (would turn bearish on disappointment). Key risks: OpenAI concentration (~50% of backlog) and heavy capex with no FCF expected next year.

bullets.title: GOOGL: $85B equity raise for AI capex signals 2027 capex heading toward $300B+
bullets.body: Google announced an $85B equity raise (including $18B stock, $16.75B mandatory convertible, $40B ATM, $10B Berkshire placement), with stock initially trading -4%. JPM's Doug Anmuth models ~$293B in 2027 capex; buyside coalescing toward $275B+. Bulls model $16-17 EPS in 2027 (30x = $510). Google also signed a $920M/month cloud compute pact with SpaceX (110k NVIDIA GPUs, Oct 2026-June 2029). Separately, Google launched Gemma 4 12B open model and secured 110,000 NVIDIA GPUs from SpaceX.

bullets.title: META: Business Agent launch positive; equity raise speculation weighed; $200/month AI agent pricing mulled
bullets.body: Meta launched its Business Agent globally on WhatsApp, popping +4%; stock then fell as reports emerged the company is weighing a tens-of-billions equity offering to fund $145B AI capex. FT also reported Microsoft and Amazon may consider similar offerings. Separately, Meta is reportedly mulling $200/month for a premium consumer AI agent tool. META ended the week down 6%, with stock reverting to early April levels.

bullets.title: ANET: JPM maintains OW, $200 PT; urges mgmt to fix guidance, pursue optical/silicon M&A
bullets.body: JPM says ANET's underlying demand growth is 45-55% YoY (adjusted for deferred revenue) vs. stated 28% FY26 guidance; historically beats by ~1,200bps. Bull case supports $5 '27 EPS at 40-45x. Analyst urges ~$12B net cash deployment into optics/silicon acquisitions to diversify from $60B TAM and counter NVDA/CSCO bundling threats. ANET has underperformed CSCO by 42% YTD, largest gap in a decade.

bullets.title: AAPL WWDC: Gemini-based Siri, agentic AI expected; historically outperforms SPX 11% into fall launches
bullets.body: JPM expects WWDC keynote (June 8, 1pm ET) to feature Gemini-based Siri with agentic capabilities and on-screen awareness. iPhone 18 base models not until C1Q27; fall is Pro/Foldable story. AAPL modeling ~$50 mid-single-digit price increases on iPhone 18 to protect margins vs. memory cost headwinds. KBCM maintains Sector Weight; trading at ~24x FY27 EV/EBITDA viewed as overvalued. Dan Ives expects 'fireworks.'

bullets.title: ADBE: Mizuho Neutral ahead of F2Q; expects solid beat but no re-rating catalyst
bullets.body: Mizuho expects solid organic revenue upside to consensus in F2Q with Semrush acquisition adding ~200bps ARR boost; management likely to reiterate FY26 10.2% YoY CC ARR guidance. But AI-first ARR is <2% of $26B total ARR—insufficient to bend growth curve. Valuation at 8.5x CY27E EV/FCF is 45-50% below Enterprise Software group median. Jefferies also flagged potential CEO announcement as enabling 'bold strategic moves.'

bullets.title: TSLA: JPMorgan upgrades to Neutral, raises PT from $145 to $475
bullets.body: JPMorgan made an analyst change and upgraded Tesla to Neutral with PT jumping from $145 to $475 (current ~$388). Separately, Opco noted TSLA sell-through improved meaningfully in EU (France, Norway, Spain) in May. China May domestic retail came in at ~47.3K units (+21% YoY).

bullets.title: ROKU: S&P 400 addition; KeyBanc OW, $150 PT on FCF inflection
bullets.body: ROKU added to S&P MidCap 400 effective June 22, up ~4% in premarket. KeyBanc maintains OW at $150, noting the index inclusion draws attention to the company's transformation: ~40% revenue now from subscriptions, EBITDA margin expanding to ~12% in 2026E, with $929M FCF projected in 2027E.

bullets.title: NFLX: Reed Hastings exits board; Jay Hoag appointed chairman
bullets.body: Netflix appointed Jay Hoag (Lead Independent Director since 2012) as Board Chairman following Reed Hastings' decision not to stand for re-election at the annual meeting. Hoag also chairs the Nominating and Governance Committee. No operational implications disclosed.

bullets.title: CIEN: $2B convertible note offering announced
bullets.body: Ciena announced a $2.0B convertible senior notes offering due 2031, with initial purchasers granted a $300M greenshoe option. Notes are fully guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis. Citi's semi recap also flagged CIEN commentary as pointing to constrained supply in 2027.

bullets.title: KLAC: Process control share hits 58%, raising CY30 EPS power toward $95+
bullets.body: JPM reports KLAC extended its #1 process control share to 58% (+80bps), with optical PWI share at ~90% and e-beam share surging from 5% (CY19) to 24% (CY25). Process control intensity reached 8.1% of WFE. Company guides above CY30 Investor Day targets toward $95+ EPS; stepped up capital returns to >90% FCF, new $7B buyback, and 21% dividend hike.

bullets.title: TTD: CRO departure after 7 months adds to exec turnover concerns
bullets.body: The Trade Desk CRO Anders Mortensen departed after only 7 months, following 4 CFO departures in 2 years. Multiple sources flagged the exit as a negative signal on management stability, with concern about potential client spending impacts. Stock was down on the week.

bullets.title: WIX: Down 10% on 20% RIF, cuts 2026 bookings guidance by ~$50M
bullets.body: WIX announced a workforce reduction of ~1,000 employees (20% RIF) and cut 2026 bookings guidance by ~$50M and revenue by ~$25M. Shares fell 10.4% in premarket Monday.

bullets.title: SHOP: UBS hosting June 9 expert call with Shopify Platinum Partner Zettler Digital
bullets.body: UBS analyst Timothy Chiodo—cited as having 'best SHOP model on Street'—is hosting a June 9 investor Zoom with Zettler Digital (400+ brands scaled) covering SMB/enterprise adoption cycles, Shop Pay monetization, and AI-commerce/Sidekick strategy.

bullets.title: RH: Citi expects inline 1Q; Estates launch timing a key 2H catalyst
bullets.body: Citi expects RH to deliver in-line 1Q results with the -2-4% revenue guidance appearing conservative. The RH Estates product line has not yet launched; timing into summer could result in 2H-weighted FY26 guidance. Citi also notes RH positioned to monetize AI trends over coming years. RH reports Thursday after close (consensus: $(2.09) EPS, $792.5M revenue).

bullets.title: DKNG: Iowa GGR +4% YoY; JPM shows 24% upside at $31 PT
bullets.body: Iowa May sports betting GGR +4% YoY with DKNG specifically +3% GGR and +3% handle in Iowa. JPM's gaming/lodging valuation tracker shows DKNG at $24.93 with $31 PT (24% upside), trading at 20.3x 2026E P/E. Digital gaming cohort (DKNG, FLUT) trades at 32x 2026E EV/EBITDA.

bullets.title: ACN: JPM cuts PT from $247 to $201, trims estimates to guidance midpoint; maintains OW
bullets.body: JPM lowering PT to $201 on December 2026 basis (13x CY27E EPS $15.35), trimming F3Q revenue to $18.7B (+3.2% FXN) and F3Q bookings to $19.5B (-1.1% YoY). AI tokenomics creating client approval delays; AI governance operationalization seen as medium-term tailwind. Stock trades at 12.5x NTM P/E or 10% FCF yield—OW maintained.
